name: harness-start
description: Harness Start plugins for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: verification-provenance-guard
plugins.description: Requires machine-checkable provenance for test, artifact, Git, and CI conclusions in completion responses.

plugins.name: execution-loop-guard
plugins.description: Detects repeated edits, blind command retries, and excessive remote polling before agents waste a session.

plugins.name: source-sanity-guard
plugins.description: Blocks backup artifacts and obvious replacement-character corruption in source files.

plugins.name: git-delivery-guards
plugins.description: Guards local Git commands, atomic commits, repository state, and unresolved merge markers.

plugins.name: code-quality-guard
plugins.description: Runs bounded JS/TS, Python, and PHP syntax, lint, and static-analysis checks after file edits.

plugins.name: encoding-guard
plugins.description: Encoding guard: blocks BOM-bearing and invalid UTF-8 text files after AI writes.

plugins.name: file-line-budget-guard
plugins.description: Ratchet-enforced file line budget guard: prevents source files from exceeding per-language line limits.

plugins.name: protected-file-guard
plugins.description: Blocks direct file-tool edits to dependency lockfiles and package-manager-owned dependency directories.

plugins.name: command-safety-guards
plugins.description: Command safety guards: deny broad recursive deletion, unbacked sed in-place edits, and cat heredoc writes outside temporary directories.

plugins.name: language-output-governance
plugins.description: Keeps agent prose aligned with a stable, configurable session language across Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: subagent-discipline
plugins.description: Injects subagent contract and return hygiene; with agent_id, ledger TTL cleanup, gitignore ensure, optional Stop gate.

plugins.name: intent-clarify-gate
plugins.description: Gates business writes during grill-me style intent clarification until 完成 or complete-option close.

plugins.name: first-principles-gate
plugins.description: Gates business writes during first-principles analysis until a structured on-disk ledger is complete and the session closes.

plugins.name: goal-task-gate
plugins.description: Arms on host /goal prompts, forces append-only decision trails under .goal-task/, and completes only with GOAL_TASK_DONE trailer plus close row.

plugins.name: markdown-format-guard
plugins.description: Checks Markdown heading structure and common formatting rules after AI write operations.

plugins.name: file-access-audit
plugins.description: Records structured agent file reads and writes to a project-local per-session JSONL trail.

plugins.name: command-exec-audit
plugins.description: Records agent shell commands with status and duration to a project-local per-session JSONL trail.
